description: A write-side create scenario that introduces a new HTTP endpoint. Beyond the write-side basics (use-case test before controller, Repository contract test, identity equality test, no code written), the architect must reflect the api-conventions skill in the controller step: a create returns 201 Created with a Location header. We assert those facts coarsely. (If 'Location' is absent, that is a genuine finding about the architect not applying the 201+Location rule — not necessarily a bad assertion.)
